items.title: Country-year warehouse, six series
items.body: Shipped. Homicide, calories, battle deaths, GDP per person, alcohol, and temperature anomaly, 1930–2026, with a regression test. Figures are computed from the snapshot.

items.title: Status bar lists every series
items.body: Shipped. The bar follows the selected country and year, including real zeros. A missing row says so.

items.title: Flexible charts
items.body: Shipped. Trend, overlay, scatter with Pearson r, rank bars, pins, year range, and log scale.

items.title: Home page topic rail and mosaic
items.body: Shipped. The rail is the current top reports from the database. Cards use the report category. Nothing is hardcoded into the grid.

items.title: Report pages with their own URLs
items.body: Shipped. Each report has SEO meta, computed analysis, sources, related links with relevance and a bias mark, and people only when a source names them. Reports are not deleted.

items.title: Report figures follow the year and country
items.body: Shipped. Year, country search, map click, and chart mode recompute the figures on the report page.

items.title: Host the app on Railway
items.body: Shipped. The Dockerfile replaced the old service. A push to main deploys. Migrations run at start. Health check identifies this service.

items.title: Bug: map not appearing
items.body: The choropleth was drawn into a canvas and then clipped. MapLibre's stylesheet set the container to position:relative with no height, so the frame looked empty. The container now fills the frame. Confirmed by forcing that rule against the live page before the fix shipped.

items.title: Write each day's public-interest finding and re-rank
items.body: Open. The table exists and the first day's rows are seeded. A pass still has to search current public topics, insert a new interest_findings row, and update report priority without deleting reports or findings.

items.title: Record a published bias rater where one exists
items.body: Open. Bias values are Unrated unless a published rater is named. Do not invent a score.

items.title: Add one citable drug-prevalence series
items.body: Open. Opioids, stimulants, or benzodiazepines, only from a stable country-year table. Do not estimate a series that has no source.

items.title: City drilldown only where a boundary table exists
items.body: Open. Not started. Skip until a real city boundary and a matching statistic exist.

items.title: Refugee or food-insecurity series
items.body: Open. Add only if a stable public CSV is found. Same database, new indicator rows.
